# NEW WEEK "? ? ?"

Very new week yes its **PEAK** go play it

## Known issues
- **Discharge** may take a minute to load due to unoptimized texture preloading, I'll fix later
- **Discharge** may crash in the second half of the song, if it does screenshot the error and I'll try and diagnose
- Songs before week **"???"** still use an outdated vignette system which is why  **"???"** has nicer vignettes, I'll update the other weeks soon
- Camera bops on **Discharge** may become out of sync near the end of the song, its just made like that sorry
- Guitar Notes in **Discharge** may be off centered sometimes, I have no idea why this happens
- **MEMORY//LEAK**'s shader may cause some slight lag before applying, I'm like 90% sure it has to do with a persons GPU most of you will probably be fine
- Discharge may have some performance issues on lower end devices ***(Hoping Rush can diagnose if so)***
